latest_release.name: v7.7.0 Release of PowerShell
latest_release.body:
﻿## [7.7.0] ### General Cmdlet Updates and Fixes - Add warning for SHA-1 File Catalog (#28358) ### Tests - Fix the regex in `ConsoleHost.Tests.ps1` used to verify help content (#28365) - Pin Linux image version to Ubuntu 24.04 for CI tests (#28357) ### Build and Packaging Improvements

Update to .NET SDK 11.0.100
  • Fix the resource string WeakCatalogHashAlgorithm (#28368)
  • Update Appx manifest to not allow updates while PS7 is running (#28361)
  • Fix module-only vPack build feed credentials (#28369)
  • Add ability to consume PowerShell modules from internal feed (#28366)
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 13420: Build ID 2785816 (#28364)
  • Update Microsoft.PowerShell.PSResourceGet to version 1.3.0-rc2 (#28363)
  • Bump github/codeql-action/upload-sarif from 4.38.3 to 4.39.1 (#28359)
  • Bump github/codeql-action from 4.38.3 to 4.39.1 (#28360)
